A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 51-page research work, including the complete appendix. Full text comparison and rendered-page inspection support a reliable comparison of text, equations, figures and tables.

before.justification: v4 reports original evaluations of eleven model configurations on ChemKGMultiHopQA, including accuracy, token usage, ablations and diagnostic analyses in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v5 retains these original benchmark results, Gold+CoT experiments and diagnostic analyses, including the supplementary results and case studies.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same training-free iterative controller, retrieval/planning loop, partial-answer state, context management and stopping procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate one- to four-hop chemistry QA using ChemKGMultiHopQA. The alternative datasets discussed in Appendix S1.6 remain screening candidates, without additional evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same eleven model/configuration entries and evaluation regimes. Table 2 retains the same three configurations and Gold Context, Gold+CoT and Iterative RAG comparisons.

E3.justification: The five-step retrieval budget, top-10 retrieval, correctness verification, analysis subsets and Gold+CoT protocol are unchanged, as are the other documented experimental settings.

E4.justification: The Gold+CoT ablation, stepwise utilization and failure analyses, appendix case studies, and Gold Context length analysis are identical in both versions.

E5.justification: Both retain the same t-test reporting in Figure 2, standard-error bars in Figure 9a and standard-deviation bars in Figure S13. No run or seed disclosures change.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match. For example, Table 1 reports GPT-4o's Iterative RAG accuracy as 81.96% in both versions; the ablation and appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The diagnostic definitions, Equations (1)–(5), and appendix damage-index definition are unchanged. No mathematical reasoning, assumptions or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about iterative retrieval surpassing static oracle evidence and the diagnostic, efficiency and adherence contributions.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations and qualifications are unchanged, including synchronization benefits, composition failures, cost/compliance tradeoffs and the single-benchmark generalization limitation in Appendix S1.6.

D1.justification: Implementation details, chunking settings, diagnostic and verification prompts, and the code/results repository link are identical. No technical or resource-access information changes.

R1.justification: Section 2, the extended literature review in Appendix S1.1, the reference list and novelty positioning are unchanged. No cited works are added or removed.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv version/date text changes, from v4 dated 10 Jun 2026 to v5 dated 31 Jul 2026. Manuscript wording and section structure are identical.

P2.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp is repositioned. Scientific figures, tables, captions and manuscript layout otherwise match; rendered pages 2–51 are pixel-identical.

improvement.justification: v5 changes only administrative arXiv stamping, its placement and its version-specific self-link. The main text and appendices preserve the same scientific evidence, reasoning, reproducibility information and readability, producing no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
